required_release_evidence: Supabase project ref and latest applied migration
Release gate result for the deploy commit
rollback_compatibility: Host web/API rollback is allowed only when schema compatibility is preserved.
Applied production migrations are forward-fixed unless destructive corruption requires PITR.
Loop and outbox workers can be disabled independently without reverting the web/API deploy.
Release evidence must record whether rollback, forward-fix, or worker pause was chosen.
